_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY. Review, then copy to .claude/settings.json (project) or .claude/settings.local.json before the unattended run. CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=80 makes every session compact at 80% of its window; the agent definitions set autoCompactWindow (absolute tokens; all models default to a 1M window): 600000 for the Sonnet/Haiku agents (~60%) and 800000 for imsrg-lead (~80%). How the percentage override combines with autoCompactWindow is undocumented, so prefer dropping CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE when the per-agent windows are used (see QUESTIONS Q19). The deny list blocks pushing, remote changes, the shared git stash, and history- or file-destroying commands (git clean would delete the untracked imsrg-devel/ and test inputs in the main checkout root). Allow rules are a convenience, not a security boundary. For a hard guarantee against pushing, the owner can also run: git -C /Users/cheshyre/Downloads/new-imsrg remote set-url --push origin DISABLED
